corpus_description: Utah FORGE well 16A(78)-32 daily drilling and completion reports. Raw PDFs stay local and untracked; this manifest pins the reviewed evaluation selection by corpus-relative path and SHA-256 only.
corpus_root_convention: 16A(78)-32_Daily_Reports directory at the repository root (git-ignored). Override with MONDAY_REPORT_FORGE_CORPUS_ROOT.
selection_notes: Fixed reviewed selection stratified across report family (drilling/completion), well phase (surface hole, coring, tangent drilling, completion wash/ream, rig release), narrative-heavy versus table-heavy layout, positive structured-extraction targets, and reviewed-absence targets. Not a first-N alphabetical sample. Changing this selection requires editing and re-reviewing this committed manifest.

coverage.layout_variation: drilling template versus completion template, plus early/mid/late phase variation within each family

documents.selection_reason: Early surface-hole daily drilling report with casing, mud, and pump tables plus BOPE-test narrative. Exercises scalar fields, table-cell splitting behavior, bare-unit mud values, and the casing no-fabrication invariant.
Mid-well coring report dominated by operational narrative. Provides the positive explicit-unit hydraulics target (standpipe pressure in psi inside narrative) and reviewed casing/survey absence.

Late tangent-drilling report with separate MD/TVD scalars and a labeled single-line directional survey. Provides the positive survey extraction target and numeric-notation stress (dot-thousands measured depth).

Daily completion report (wash/ream and tripping operations) with a time log table. Exercises the completion template, document-type classification, and the casing no-fabrication invariant against tripping narrative.
Final completion report (rig release, pipe laydown). Second completion template sample for stability, with the inch-fraction laydown narrative that stresses the casing no-fabrication invariant.
